## Diagnosis
Every opening paragraph closes by restating its first sentence rather than on a thing, so the reader is told three times that the agent must be told.

## Suggestions
### 1
Original: Different seats, one claim.
Replacement: CUT
Buys: The four attributions already show the seats; the fragment is the author pointing at his own arrangement.

### 2
Original: Everyone agrees the agent needs written guidance.
Replacement: CUT
Buys: Paragraph one ended on this claim; said again it reads as a summary slide.

## Defect classes
### A
Class: a sentence that announces its paragraph instead of being it
Instance: Different seats, one claim.
Instance: Everyone agrees the agent needs written guidance.
Instance: The tool makers agree on the need before they agree on much else.
Instance: The same people name the gap.
Sweep: every paragraph opening and closing sentence in the introduction

## Paragraph move
Lift the dated scene into the opening.
